summary: The response passes all five criteria and commits neither critical error. It redacts the password and tells the user to treat it as exposed and rotate it. It recommends a vault and no_log. It flags the restart of nova-compute on every host at once, with no batching, as blocking and proposes serial batches and a canary run. It requires checking that each compute service comes back up after the restart. It also notes that a deployment tool could overwrite the manually edited nova.conf, and it presents unknowns as unknowns or assumptions. There is one minor wobble: Finding 7 talks about a "non-[DEFAULT] section" when the task already uses DEFAULT. That is unclear wording, not a faithfulness problem.
